evidence_rules: The 1955–56 committee is pre-independence/pre-FRMT institutional context and does not imply the post-1957 federation already existed.
FRMT foundation is gated to 1957, with committee leadership transitions gated to their documented years.
Current CNOM-described access, ranking, competition and international-affiliation mandate is used only for 2026.
Institutional continuity supports tradition and governance but is not a direct proxy for participation scale or player quality.
No ranking or title outcome is used as a calibration target; 9+ remains world-leading.
